description: One derived JSON document: inventory (the SBOM's metadata.component purl, or its path with warning sbom_unnamed), named_by, components (one record per distinct purl, nested components flattened, each carrying inventory and named_by), held (the inventory's prior components), unidentified (components with no purl, never records) and count (every component the SBOM lists, unidentified included: a count above the records marks the read incomplete, so absence retires nothing).
name: sbom.components.result
